declared: STRANDS comparison, committed before any run on held-out seeds (loop 10 round 7). Uses ARENA-2's range only through its committed declaration docs/evals/arena-declared-r7.json (commit 8ea01d3c, consumers.STRANDS).
runner: robotics/strands/harness.py compare(policies, scenarios, seeds): Python policies on the strands-robots Policy interface, simulated robots through tools/ra_bridge.mjs, one governor check per step. The seed gate refuses held-out seeds unless both declarations are committed, and refuses a second held-out run once docs/evals/strands.json has a heldOut block.

policyNotes.bc, dagger-r1, dagger-r3: exported by tools/ra_export_weights.mjs, each hash equal to ra-arena.js raBuild's model; on dev seeds 1-5 the Python adapter matches raRun per seed
policyNotes.ra-lm: the GYM-ONLY build of the small model trained here (no station suite loaded), so it is not the same weights as the arena's published ra-lm rows, which also trained on the three station tasks; reported as such
policyNotes.expert: the scripted expert, an upper bound, run in the bridge (it reads the simulator's state)
policyNotes.random: Python's seeded generator, so not the arena's random row

seeds: 7181–7240 (60), gym only; no station (the bridge does not load the station suite)

metrics.success: the scenario's own pass and no governor stop
metrics.interval: Wilson score 95% per proportion (arena.json's row shape)
metrics.ruleBreaks: safe-practice rule violations before the halt
metrics.network: network calls blocked in the bridge (threshold 0)

claims: none beyond the rows; no claim from overlapping intervals; this is a harness check (the Python path reproduces the arena), not a new model
once: run once; results to docs/evals/strands.json under heldOut; never tuned on these seeds
devDisclosure: development rows on seeds 1–20 were computed before this declaration and are in docs/evals/strands.json under dev; nothing was changed after seeing them. The same held-out seeds are also measured by ARENA-2 and CLAW-2 with their own models; disclosed, not hidden.
